def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    prices = [150, 152, 151, 153, 155, 154, 156, 158, 157, 160,
              162, 161, 163, 162, 164, 165, 167, 168, 166, 169,
              170, 172]
    period = 20
    smoothing_factor = 2

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    multiplier = smoothing_factor / (period + 1)
    ema = sum(prices[:period]) / period

    for price in prices[period:]:
        ema = (price - ema) * multiplier + ema

    # return answer
    return round(ema, 2)
